key_point: The fan who called Keanu breathtaking
title: The fan who called Keanu breathtaking
caption: The fan who told Keanu Reeves he was breathtaking asked CD Projekt to donate to a children's hospital instead of giving him a free game. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #cyberpunk2077 #keanureeves

instagram.caption:
At E3 2019, Keanu Reeves walked on stage for Cyberpunk 2077. A fan shouted: You're breathtaking!

Keanu pointed at him and said: You're breathtaking! You're all breathtaking! The clip went everywhere.

CD Projekt offered the fan, Peter Sark, a free collector's edition. He asked them to donate a go-kart to a children's hospital instead, and they did.

Would you have taken the free copy?
